DATAMAPPER PRO · PRIVACY

Your data deserves
straight answers.

How DataMapper Pro handles imported files, saved settings, subscription licenses, and optional AI features.

Draft for release review · October 7, 2026

1. Scope

This policy describes the DataMapper Pro Chrome extension from SquatchBro Labs. The website privacy notice separately describes our website. Third-party payment and AI services have their own privacy practices.

2. File processing

DataMapper Pro is designed to import structured data, apply transformations, preview results, and export files locally in the browser. Ordinary file transformations are not intended to upload your datasets to a SquatchBro Labs server. Optional AI features are different: data included in AI requests is transmitted to the AI provider.

3. Information saved in Chrome

The extension uses Chrome extension storage for settings, projects or recipes, preferences, license keys, license activation instance identifiers, plan status, and validation timestamps, depending on features used. This enables licenses and settings to persist when the extension is reopened.

If you provide an OpenAI API key, the extension may retain it in extension storage for subsequent requests. Treat that key as sensitive. Browser extension storage is not the same as a dedicated encrypted secrets vault; avoid using sensitive credentials on shared browser profiles.

4. Payments and license validation

Purchases take place through Lemon Squeezy's hosted checkout. DataMapper Pro does not collect your payment card number inside the extension. Lemon Squeezy handles payment and subscription information.

License activation, validation, and deactivation communicate with Lemon Squeezy's licensing service. Requests can include the license key and activation instance information; the service may also receive technical connection information such as IP addresses. Read Lemon Squeezy's privacy policy.

5. Optional AI features

AI features are optional. When used, DataMapper Pro may transmit your instructions and relevant context to OpenAI, potentially including field names, example values, or other data you provide. Do not submit confidential, regulated, or personal data unless permitted by your organization's policies and the provider's terms.

AI requests are subject to OpenAI's privacy policy and applicable API terms. If you use your own API key, OpenAI API charges may be separate from your DataMapper subscription.

6. Sharing and security

DataMapper Pro uses external services for checkout, license verification, and optional AI functionality. Local transformation workflows do not require selling imported datasets. No software or internet transmission can guarantee absolute security. Protect your Chrome profile, credentials, and exported files.

7. Choices and deletion

  • Do not use AI features if you do not wish to send content to an AI provider.
  • Use the extension's Deactivate This Device control to release a license activation.
  • Uninstalling the extension or clearing its extension storage can remove local settings, saved recipes, and license information. This does not delete exported files or third-party payment or AI records.
  • For subscription or billing records, use Lemon Squeezy's customer tools or contact support.

8. Contact and changes

For privacy questions, email support@squatchbrolabs.com (Squatch Guide, SquatchBro Labs). We will update this notice as product practices change.
